prompt: How old was Harvard University, when the person whom the longest river in British Columbia is named after, was born?  The river in question only flows within the confines of British Columbia and does not enter any other province or territory.
answer: The river is the **Fraser River**, named after explorer **Simon Fraser**, who was born in **1776**. Harvard University was founded in **1636**, so it was **140 years old** when he was born (or about 139 years and 8 months, depending on the exact founding-date calculation).
